title: Generated FIELD/path-object/PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX OBJECTS allocation rollback and retry
scope: AC1027 whole-file dxfRW::write with a locally generated FIELD, FIELDLIST member, MOTIONPATH, CURVEPATH, POINTPATH, LINE target, and one PARTIALVIEWINGINDEX entry in the same OBJECTS callback; ASCII and Binary.

validation.perOffset: one-shot std::bad_alloc across the FIELD, FIELDLIST, MOTIONPATH, CURVEPATH, POINTPATH, then PARTIALVIEWINGINDEX OBJECTS callback; whole-file destination sentinel is preserved, caller object fields and entity geometry remain intact, same-codec retry restores the source LINE handle, reproduces calibration bytes, and typed readback verifies FIELD values, FIELDLIST membership, all path fields, and the LINE/PVI target graph and extents

limits: The earlier ENTITIES callback commits its minted handle to the caller's LINE before a later OBJECTS callback fails. The test records this cross-stage caller mutation and restores the source handle before retry; whole-operation rollback of previously emitted caller entities remains open.
Generated serializer transaction and typed DXF readback evidence only; it does not qualify native consumer behavior, external producers, DWG output, or broad support.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added; test output uses its build scratch directory.
